headline: 'Real Brave Hearts' Invest in 'Leverage' Even Now… Institutions Bet on 'Inverse Leverage' [Investment 360]
summary: The KOSPI plunged more than 5% on 'Black Tuesday,' while individual and institutional investors in Korean ETFs showed diverging positioning. Individuals were betting on rising prices through leveraged ETFs.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main stock index, covering the country's largest listed companies. Its moves reflect broad sentiment toward Korean equities and the won-denominated market.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The index itself fell more than 5% in the session described.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The input reports a single-session drop of more than 5% in the KOSPI, with investors positioned differently in leveraged and inverse ETFs. It does not give a cause for the decline.
